QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. The real member is renamed, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(foo)` fails to compile for anyone who writes it.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the compile-time renaming of the member, but it never says the struct layout stays visible and sized, and the item needs that contrast with hiding the layout.
